meta.title: Meridian Immigration Law | Chicago
meta.desc: Immigration lawyers in Chicago. Family petitions, work visas, asylum, citizenship and removal defense. Free first consultation in five languages.

hero.h1: Your case explained in your own language.
hero.lede: We handle family petitions, work visas, asylum, citizenship and removal defense. The first consultation is free, and we will tell you honestly whether you have a case before you pay anything.

items.p: You speak to someone in your language, not through a family member and not through an app.
If your case is weak, we say so at the free consultation. We would rather lose the fee than take your money for nothing.
You know the cost before you sign. No hourly surprises and no charge for a phone call.
What you tell us stays with us, whatever your status. We do not share information with anyone.

services.title: Five areas, done properly
services.lede: We are a small firm and we say no to work outside these areas, because doing one thing well is worth more to you than doing everything adequately.

items.p: Spouse, parent, child and sibling petitions, adjustment of status, and consular processing.
H-1B, L-1, O-1 and TN, plus employer sponsorship and labor certification.
Affirmative and defensive asylum, withholding of removal, and Convention Against Torture claims.
Naturalization, the civics interview, and certificates of citizenship for children.
Immigration court representation, bond hearings, cancellation of removal, and appeals.

steps.p: Thirty minutes, in your language, in person or by phone. Bring whatever documents you have. You will leave knowing whether you have a case.
If we take your case you get a flat fee in writing, with exactly what it covers and what it does not, before you pay anything.
We prepare the filing, we track it, and we tell you when something changes. You can always reach the person handling your case.

about.title: A small firm on purpose
about.p1: Meridian is four people. That is deliberate: it means the person who takes your consultation is the person who handles your file, and you are never handed to someone who has to read your case from scratch.
about.p2: Between us we speak English, Spanish, Polish, Mandarin and Arabic. Most of our clients come from someone we have already helped.

contact.title: Come and talk to us
contact.hoursVal: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Saturday by appointment.

disclaimer: This website is for general information only and is not legal advice. Using this site or sending a message does not create a lawyer-client relationship. Immigration law changes often and outcomes depend on the facts of your case.
